featureReviews.notes: Silhouette unchanged from the blockout (Tier-1 IoU 0.898): top, six legs, stretchers, end X braces, blade and log in place.
The iron arbor hub now sits at the blade centre just above the top line, as in the reference; it is a little small (reference boss is about a quarter of the blade diameter) and still faceted.
Stretchers sit on the outer leg faces front and back with the back pair visible through the gaps; X braces at both ends read in the side views.

summary: Structural pass adds the arbor hub; frame members and hierarchy are complete (Tier-1 IoU 0.898, aspect 0.011, scale 0.0003; turntable, self-intersection and attachment pass), but the critical blade read is held back by an undersized, faceted hub: refine the spec and rebuild this pass.
matched: arbor hub at the blade centre
stretchers and end braces as separate members
log in front of the blade's right half
mismatches: hub a little small and faceted
